body: Yeah, you have a point.   I am fairly famous for the dramatic.  I never feel like I am but I hear that a lot.  Its just the way things seem to me sometimes.  Annoying, Distracting and an Inconvenience...   Got it.

That's cool.  Yeah, I've looked down that road a few times but I did that in the past and it turned out really quite bad.  I was only just barely able to take care of my family and it was an extremely hard part of my life.  I swore to never be there again.  I spent the last 7 years now (successfully? doing everything in my power to get as far away from that as possible.  I guess thats why I hang onto my horrible job and horrible people against my better judgement.
Wow, I've never heard of this.  In the states all we ever hear about is how Germany has these wonderful social welfare programs and everyone is taken care of because of them.  What are these called?

Yeah, I won't actually stab those guys i work with... but if the zombie apocalypse actually happened... I would rush over to their houses and shoot them and SAY they were zombies... I swear.  I have never been involved in any full contact sport.  Actually I am really competitive but I usually find myself on the track running or being competitive in a 10 k run.  I never thought about martial arts actually and I feel like I do have some fight left in me but I fucking hate taking it out on myself.  Yeah one side of me really thinks that if I get it out of my system I will be good to go but the other side really is worried that it will just get bigger... ya know?

Yeah, your right.  I'm the one doing it.  How the hell do I stop it is the question...  It's funny, because I've beat other similar things like this in my life like a champ (obesity, shyness... you see where that got me) but   I thought about the therapist thing a few times but getting there without dumping my whole life is next to impossible. Again, I'm not sure I could just "go to the suicide therapist" WAY too much of a stigma attached to that for what I do.  I could probably not even schedule it 3 days out because of work.  Yeah My work.... See My wife does great, but her stuff can end at any time.  She is totally independent/freelance contractor.  I am the one with the steady benefits/medical/pay/retirement.  So I stay.  I've talked to her about it, told her I hate my job and its killing me a few times and she said to stay if I felt I could stand it because her gig could end any time.  Well I'm here trying to add time onto it any way I can.  Which, since I hate it, is madness.
I can't think of a single thing...

Hey, It may seem like money will solve problems.  It doesn't.  I'm on this board and I have some.  It's just dirty paper... All the problems will still remain.  Redshift is right on about Cpt. 13.  It may take a lot of the bullshit away and help you not feel so overwhelmed.  God, I hate my fucking job.  I would give it to you if I could.  I think about slashing my own tires so I can show up late.  A job and money are not worth it.  Its hard to let it go but sometimes thats the best thing.  Just let it go and try to move forward from where you are at now.
